note: The monumental gate (the user, 2026-09-28: 'a colosseum should feel monumental'): the approved section's framing with the arch about three times the gladiator's height (about 120 px of 360), two seeds, the user's image as the style.

body.description: a close top-down view from high above of the lower edge of a Roman colosseum arena, at the scale of a person: packed ochre sand with a few small rocks fills the upper half, the massive curved stone arena wall runs across the lower half, and in its middle a monumental arched gate, very tall and wide, its arch reaching a third of the image's height, framed by heavy stone pilasters, the first rows of stone stands beside it; the gate dwarfs everything; detailed, crisp pixel art at a fine scale; no people, no lettering; the same style as the reference
